headline: Binance customers have pulled a net $4.7B since the hack, more coins are due to reopen Tuesday, and North Korea denies it was behind the theft.

stories.title: Binance net withdrawals reach about $4.7B; more coins due to reopen Tuesday
stories.summary: Since Binance reopened withdrawals after its record hack, customers have taken out about $4.7B more than they put in. That is a small slice of the exchange's assets, and money is also coming back in. Withdrawals for more coins and networks are due to restart from Tuesday 3 Nov, and a wider proof of reserves follows on 4 Nov.
points: Net outflows hit $4.7B by Monday morning London time, under 4% of Binance's $128B in assets, per Bloomberg. CoinDesk instead cites $171B, the amount Binance reported holding before the attack.
Reuters puts net outflows at $4.72B, with $2.7B of customer money flowing in since Sunday.
Binance says it has replaced about 95% of the affected assets; CZ says the gap was covered from Binance's own balance sheet, per CoinDesk.
More networks and coins reopen gradually from 3 Nov, and Binance has not yet said which, per TokenPost.
A broader proof-of-reserves snapshot is planned for 4 Nov, and the proof takes about 40 to 50 hours to generate, per TokenPost.

stories.title: North Korea denies the Binance hack as tracers find the loot spread over about 12,000 wallets
stories.summary: North Korea has called the FBI's claim that it was behind the Binance theft 'absurd'. Blockchain firm Elliptic says the stolen money was moved through about 12,000 wallets in under four days. About 44% has been frozen or seized, but over $3B is still in the hackers' hands.
points: Kim Yo Jong called the FBI's allegation 'absurd rhetoric' and 'a grave political provocation', per AFP.
Elliptic puts the theft at $6.43B, with about $2.85B (44%) frozen or seized, per Decrypt.
About $3.24B is still in hacker-linked addresses, including 18,270 BTC that has not moved, per Decrypt.
Circle froze $823M of stolen USDC according to Decrypt; Reuters reports Circle froze more than $1.1B.

sources.label: AFP via Arab News: North Korea denial
Decrypt: a new wallet every 25 seconds
Reuters via Korea Times: Circle freeze

stories.title: Morgan Stanley cuts Coinbase to Underweight as crypto funds keep losing money
stories.summary: Morgan Stanley downgraded Coinbase and cut its price target by more than half, citing weak trading and uncertainty after the Binance hack. Coinbase shares fell again on Monday. US spot bitcoin funds had their biggest one-day outflow since June on Friday, and ether funds had a record month of outflows in October.
points: Morgan Stanley moved Coinbase to Underweight from Equal-weight and cut its target to $120 from $258, per CoinDesk.
Coinbase closed at $137.80 on Monday, down 4%, per CoinDesk.
US spot bitcoin ETFs lost $643.3M on Friday 30 Oct, the biggest one-day outflow since 25 June, per CoinDesk citing SoSoValue.
US-listed ether ETFs had their largest monthly outflow on record in October, $1.61B, per CoinDesk.
